agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider: status update on Burnaby civic projects
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council will receive a status update on significant civic projects at its September 2026 meeting. The Mintara Restaurant patio expansion (2,000 sq ft enclosed all-weather patio) is on schedule with handover expected late Q3 2026. The Shadbolt Centre theatre and art studios are 95% complete, trending ahead of schedule with handover moved up from Q1 2027 to Q4 2026. The Burnaby Lake Recreation Centre (ten-lane 50m pool, NHL-sized arena) is over 70% complete with handover anticipated Q1 2028. A new 142,000 sq ft RCMP detachment is under construction at Ledger and Norland Avenues. Utility and roadworks around Burnaby Lake will cause some traffic impacts in coming months.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Monitor the September 2026 status update for construction timelines and traffic impacts, particularly around Burnaby Lake Recreation Centre.
